commits.message: single-card patch: Gleaming Splendor for Alhammarret's Archive
Greater Auramancy for Lightning Greaves: shroud on Heliod (an enchantment creature) and on every other enchantment, same two mana; work in progress on the proposed v1.2.2 list

staged.why: a Treasure whenever an opponent draws their second card in a turn, in a deck that makes every opponent draw every turn, plus a group-draw activation; the Archive's lifegain half is off-plan here

Heliod is an enchantment creature, so Auramancy's shroud covers him the way Greaves did and also covers Smothering Tithe, Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Gleaming Splendor and the pillowfort; Greaves' haste is unused. Game 001 was lost to a Swords redirected onto Heliod. Blind to wipes and counter wars; Karametra's Blessing can no longer target Heliod once it resolves.

proposal.why: Pilot's call 2026-09-11: Gleaming Splendor for Alhammarret's Archive. The instrument cannot see it — Forge at 40 games (MDE 0.34, delta -0.028, CI [-0.23, +0.19]) and a goldfish that does not read the second-draw Treasure trigger — so the decision is on theory: a Treasure per opponent per turn in a deck that makes every opponent draw every turn, and it stacks with Smothering Tithe. The Archive's lifegain half was off-plan. Pilot's call 2026-09-12: Greater Auramancy for Lightning Greaves. Heliod is an enchantment creature, so the shroud covers him as Greaves did, and it also covers Tithe, Rhystic Study, Remora, Splendor and the pillowfort; the haste was unused. Game 001 was lost to a Swords redirected onto Heliod. Blind to wipes and counter wars, and Karametra's Blessing can no longer target Heliod once it resolves. Nothing on the bench measures protection. Two to buy.
